scenes.tts: Every neurotrophin binds p seventy five. So what does p seventy five do on its own?
scenes.caption: Every neurotrophin binds p75. So what does p75 do on its own?
scenes.visual: Title card: The Receptor That Can Kill. A p75 receptor alone on a membrane.
scenes.narration: Every neurotrophin binds p75. So what does p75 do on its own?

scenes.tts: In the mid nineteen nineties, two groups found that it can kill. Barde's group showed this in the developing chick retina.
scenes.caption: In the mid-1990s, two groups found that it can kill. Barde's group showed this in the developing chick retina.
scenes.visual: A chick retina; some cells fade. On screen: mid-1990s. Barde's group: NGF kills through p75.
scenes.narration: In the mid-1990s, two groups found that it can kill. Barde's group showed this in the developing chick retina.

scenes.tts: Chao's group reported that N G F kills cultured rat oligodendrocytes.
scenes.caption: Chao's group reported that NGF kills cultured rat oligodendrocytes.
scenes.visual: A dish of oligodendrocytes wrapping myelin. On screen: Chao's group.
scenes.narration: Chao's group reported that NGF kills cultured rat oligodendrocytes.

scenes.tts: These are the myelin making cells of the brain and spinal cord. They lack Track A.
scenes.caption: These are the myelin-making cells of the brain and spinal cord. They lack TrkA.
scenes.visual: The oligodendrocyte surface shows p75 and no TrkA. NGF binds; the cell dies.
scenes.narration: These are the myelin-making cells of the brain and spinal cord. They lack TrkA.

scenes.tts: With no Track receptor to read stay alive, p seventy five can read die.
scenes.caption: With no Trk receptor to read stay alive, p75 can read die.
scenes.visual: Caption on screen: no Trk, so p75 can read die.
scenes.narration: With no Trk receptor to read stay alive, p75 can read die.

scenes.tts: The oligodendrocyte experiments were done in culture, where N G F is often added at nanomolar levels. The retina result involved N G F the tissue makes itself. Chapter six shows why dose matters.
scenes.caption: The oligodendrocyte experiments were done in culture, where NGF is often added at nanomolar levels. The retina result involved NGF the tissue makes itself. Chapter six shows why dose matters.
scenes.visual: Small note on the oligodendrocyte dish: oligodendrocyte culture dose, nanomolar. Small note on the retina: the tissue's own NGF. Arrow: chapter 6.
scenes.narration: The oligodendrocyte experiments were done in culture, where NGF is often added at nanomolar levels. The retina result involved NGF the tissue makes itself. Chapter six shows why dose matters.

scenes.tts: Yet the precursor has something mature N G F lacks: a pro domain that sortilin grips, so a p seventy five and sortilin pair can hold it tightly.
scenes.caption: Yet the precursor has something mature NGF lacks: a pro-domain that sortilin grips, so a p75 and sortilin pair can hold it tightly.
scenes.visual: Mature NGF on p75 alone as a low-affinity contact; a proNGF shape nearby with its pro-domain highlighted and sortilin beside p75.
scenes.narration: Yet the precursor has something mature NGF lacks: a pro-domain that sortilin grips, so a p75 and sortilin pair can hold it tightly.

scenes.tts: Like most secreted proteins, N G F is made as a longer chain, pro N G F.
scenes.caption: Like most secreted proteins, NGF is made as a longer chain, proNGF.
scenes.visual: NGF drawn with a tail at its front. Label: proNGF.
scenes.narration: Like most secreted proteins, NGF is made as a longer chain, proNGF.

scenes.tts: The extra stretch at its front is called the pro domain.
scenes.caption: The extra stretch at its front is called the pro-domain.
scenes.visual: The tail highlights. Label: pro-domain.
scenes.narration: The extra stretch at its front is called the pro-domain.

scenes.tts: The accepted view had been that the pro domain is trimmed inside the cell.
scenes.caption: The accepted view had been that the pro-domain is trimmed inside the cell.
scenes.visual: Inside a cell, scissors cut the tail before secretion. Label: the accepted view.
scenes.narration: The accepted view had been that the pro-domain is trimmed inside the cell.

scenes.tts: In 2001, Ramee Lee, Pouneh Kermani, Kenneth Teng and Barbara Hempstead added to that picture.
scenes.visual: On screen: Lee, Kermani, Teng and Hempstead, 2001.
scenes.narration: In 2001, Ramee Lee, Pouneh Kermani, Kenneth Teng and Barbara Hempstead added to that picture.

scenes.tts: Cells can secrete some pro N G F uncut. Enzymes outside the cell can then cut it.
scenes.caption: Cells can secrete some proNGF uncut. Enzymes outside the cell can then cut it.
scenes.visual: Some proNGF leaves the cell with its tail on; scissors wait outside.
scenes.narration: Cells can secrete some proNGF uncut. Enzymes outside the cell can then cut it.

scenes.tts: Plasmin can, a protease made from the blood protein plasminogen. So can particular matrix metalloproteinases.
scenes.visual: Plasminogen converts to plasmin, which snips the tail; a matrix metalloproteinase snips another proNGF.
scenes.narration: Plasmin can, a protease made from the blood protein plasminogen. So can particular matrix metalloproteinases.

scenes.tts: To test the precursor alone, mutate its cut sites so proteases cannot trim it.
scenes.visual: Cut sites on the tail turn to locks. Label: uncleavable proNGF.
scenes.narration: To test the precursor alone, mutate its cut sites so proteases cannot trim it.

scenes.tts: Take cultured cells with p seventy five and sortilin, but little Track A.
scenes.caption: Take cultured cells with p75 and sortilin, but little TrkA.
scenes.visual: A test cell with p75 and sortilin and only a trace of TrkA.
scenes.narration: Take cultured cells with p75 and sortilin, but little TrkA.

scenes.tts: Give them mature N G F, or the uncleavable precursor, at the same concentration. Then block p seventy five. Predict each result.
scenes.caption: Give them mature NGF, or the uncleavable precursor, at the same concentration. Then block p75. Predict each result.
scenes.visual: A table builds: rows are test cells; columns are mature NGF, uncleavable proNGF, proNGF with p75 blocked. All cells show question marks.
scenes.narration: Give them mature NGF, or the uncleavable precursor, at the same concentration. Then block p75. Predict each result.

scenes.tts: In this worked example, at a low dose, mature N G F added no death. The uncleavable precursor killed the cells.
scenes.caption: In this worked example, at a low dose, mature NGF added no death. The uncleavable precursor killed the cells.
scenes.visual: Column one: no added death. Column two: more cells die. On screen: p75 and sortilin cells, little TrkA; same low dose of each form; worked example after Lee et al., 2001, and Nykjaer et al., 2004.
scenes.narration: In this worked example, at a low dose, mature NGF added no death. The uncleavable precursor killed the cells.

scenes.tts: An antibody that blocks p seventy five prevented that killing. So did cells from mice lacking p seventy five.
scenes.caption: An antibody that blocks p75 prevented that killing. So did cells from mice lacking p75.
scenes.visual: Column three: no added death. Notes: anti-p75 antibody; p75-null cells.
scenes.narration: An antibody that blocks p75 prevented that killing. So did cells from mice lacking p75.

scenes.tts: So the precursor kills through p seventy five, without being trimmed.
scenes.caption: So the precursor kills through p75, without being trimmed.
scenes.visual: Arrow from uncut proNGF to p75 to death.
scenes.narration: So the precursor kills through p75, without being trimmed.

scenes.tts: In Lee's experiments, uncut pro N G F also triggered apoptosis of cultured sympathetic neurons.
scenes.caption: In Lee's experiments, uncut proNGF also triggered apoptosis of cultured sympathetic neurons.
scenes.visual: A second row for sympathetic neurons: proNGF, cells die.
scenes.narration: In Lee's experiments, uncut proNGF also triggered apoptosis of cultured sympathetic neurons.

scenes.tts: It bound p seventy five tightly, and activated Track A very little.
scenes.caption: It bound p75 tightly, and activated TrkA very little.
scenes.visual: In that row, proNGF engages p75 with sortilin; TrkA barely lit.
scenes.narration: It bound p75 tightly, and activated TrkA very little.

scenes.tts: Mature N G F kept the same kind of neuron alive, through Track A.
scenes.caption: Mature NGF kept the same kind of neuron alive, through TrkA.
scenes.visual: Mature NGF column for sympathetic neurons: survive.
scenes.narration: Mature NGF kept the same kind of neuron alive, through TrkA.

scenes.tts: In 2004, Anders Nykjaer, Claus Munck Petersen and colleagues found the missing partner.
scenes.caption: In 2004, Anders Nykjær, Claus Munck Petersen and colleagues found the missing partner.
scenes.visual: On screen: Nykjær, Petersen and colleagues, 2004.
scenes.narration: In 2004, Anders Nykjær, Claus Munck Petersen and colleagues found the missing partner.

scenes.tts: p seventy five needs sortilin to deliver this death signal.
scenes.caption: p75 needs sortilin to deliver this death signal.
scenes.visual: Sortilin joins p75 on the membrane.
scenes.narration: p75 needs sortilin to deliver this death signal.

scenes.tts: Sortilin grips the pro domain, while p seventy five grips the mature part.
scenes.caption: Sortilin grips the pro-domain, while p75 grips the mature part.
scenes.visual: Sortilin binds the tail; p75 binds the body of the factor.
scenes.narration: Sortilin grips the pro-domain, while p75 grips the mature part.

scenes.tts: This killing was shown in culture and in rodent injury models.
scenes.visual: Scope card: culture, oligodendrocyte lineage, injury models.
scenes.narration: This killing was shown in culture and in rodent injury models.

scenes.tts: How much it adds to the normal deaths of development is less clear.
scenes.visual: Scope card adds: normal development, less clear.
scenes.narration: How much it adds to the normal deaths of development is less clear.

scenes.tts: Another group found that uncleavable pro N G F kept sympathetic neurons alive, through Track A. It did so less well.
scenes.caption: Another group found that uncleavable proNGF kept sympathetic neurons alive, through TrkA. It did so less well.
scenes.visual: A sympathetic neuron survives on proNGF, dimly. On screen: weaker survival.
scenes.narration: Another group found that uncleavable proNGF kept sympathetic neurons alive, through TrkA. It did so less well.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: p seventy five can read a neurotrophin as die. With sortilin, it reads the uncut precursor that way.
scenes.caption: The takeaway: p75 can read a neurotrophin as die. With sortilin, it reads the uncut precursor that way.
scenes.visual: Takeaway on screen: p75 can read die; with sortilin, it reads the uncut precursor that way.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: p75 can read a neurotrophin as die. With sortilin, it reads the uncut precursor that way.
